name: Conceptual Sketch UI
summary: Pencil and ink lines, rough outlines, margin notes, arrows and annotations on a pale ground. It shows an idea before it is finished, and feels like a designer's notebook.

philosophy.core_thesis: The page shows thinking: a rough line says the idea is open and honest.
design_principles: Draw every shape with a wobbly line: a stroke of 1.5px to 2.5px with a roughness of 1px to 2px and no perfect curve.
Use a paper ground (#FAF8F2) with a grid of 24px at 6% opacity, or a dot grid of 24px.
Colour in ink (#1D2A44) and add 1 highlighter accent (#FFE066) at 60% opacity for no more than 8% of the surface.
Add margin notes in a hand face at 18px to 22px with an arrow (a curved line of 2px) to the part they explain.
Hatch shadows with 3 to 6 diagonal lines at 45° and 4px gap instead of a soft shadow.
Number steps in circles of 28px to 36px and link them with dashed lines of 2px (6px dash, 4px gap).
Leave 2 or more boxes as empty placeholders with a cross, as in a wireframe.

layout.grid_mechanics: A loose page on a 24px grid; blocks sit as boxes with rough outlines; notes and arrows overlap the edges.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 30% to 40% of the surface is empty; gaps are 16px to 48px.
layout.alignment_rules: Flush left blocks; notes slightly rotated by -3° to +3°; arrows join items.
layout.container_geometry: Hand-drawn rectangles with 4px to 12px wobble; circles for steps; dashed frames for placeholders.

font_pairings.note: A fast pen for margin notes.

hierarchy_rules: Use one weight (400) in the hand face and 400 and 700 in the sans.
Set titles in the hand face and body in the sans.
Set annotations at 18px in the ink colour.

color.palette_structure: Pale paper, blue-black ink and one highlighter.
color.contrast_rules: Ink on paper holds 13:1; the highlighter is a background only, with ink text on it.
color.surface_treatment: Flat paper with a faint grid at 6% and no gradient.
color.light_and_shadow: Hatch: lines at 45° with a 4px gap in the ink colour at 40%; no soft shadow.

materiality.surface_simulation: Paper, pencil and ink in a notebook.
materiality.border_rules: A wobbly 2px ink line; dashed for ideas that are not final.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur; hatch shadows; no elevation.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Hand-drawn 2px icons with round caps and a slight wobble; arrows, stars and circled numbers.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Wireframes, doodles, arrows, boxes with crosses and sketched products.

motion.transition_physics: Drawn: lines draw in with a stroke animation over 600ms to 900ms; notes appear with a 4px jitter; no springs.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover re-draws the outline in 300ms and shades the box with a highlighter at 40%; active state fills it.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels invited into an idea that is still being made.

avoid_when: The brand must look finished and premium.
The page needs precise product photography.
The audience expects a corporate tone.

modifiers.how: Straighten lines, use a grid of 8px and a neo-grotesque; keep the ink and one accent.
Add tape, photos and a coloured paper ground.
Replace the sketch lines by solid fills of 2px radius.

pack.why: A hand-drawn line family with a slight wobble that matches pencil lines.

ground.why: A sketch page is drawn on grid paper, with one marker stroke of colour.

tailwind.classes: rounded-md border-2 border-[#1D2A44] bg-[#FFE066] px-5 py-2 font-bold text-[#1D2A44] transition-colors duration-300 hover:bg-[#FFD21F]

sources.title: Example: Hand-drawn portfolios in the Awwwards sketch category (2016–2024)
